newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa cabinet sees changes to tender policies.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa cabinet sees changes to tender policies.

text.p: South Africa's cabinet called for public comment on Wednesday on proposals to allow smaller businesses greater access to public sector tenders, saying that current policies favoured large enterprises.

"It is felt that the current tender board policies tend to favour the larger and better-established businesses and do not allow easy access for smaller businesses in the mainstream procurement activities which are funded by the public sector," Cabinet Secretary Jakes Gerwel told a news briefing.

Announcing that a green paper would be issued as a discussion document to allow for public comment, Gerwel said the intention was to empower emerging small business. A white paper will follow once discussions on the green paper are concluded.
The issue was brought before cabinet by the Finance Ministry on behalf of the Department of State Expenditure.
